members.name: Gulf of Mexico water temperature (HYCOM)
members.description: Sea water temperature (°C) from HYCOM GOMu 0.04° expt_90.1m000 on 2022-08-15 00:00 UTC, 0–1000 m resampled to 25 layers of 40 m, vertical exaggeration ×50. Generated with `apps/terriamap/buildprocess/hycom-voxels.mjs` from https://tds.hycom.org/thredds/dodsC/GOMu0.04/expt_90.1m000.

members.name: GeoTOP Amsterdam lithology (online)
members.description: GeoTOP lithology classes (0 anthropogenic, 1 peat, 2 clay, 3 clayey sand, 5 fine sand, 6 medium sand, 7 coarse sand, 8 gravel) of the Dutch national subsurface model (BRO / TNO), streamed online from https://bedrock.engineer/geotop-voxels/.

members.name: Temperatura – modello fluidodinamico (Eolie)
members.description: Temperatura (°C, proprietà `T`) delle 15.444 celle di un modello fluidodinamico (26 × 27 colonne × 22 strati, quote −1448…+250 m) presso Panarea, voxelizzate nel browser dal GeoJSON di punti. Volume sollevato di 1500 m per renderlo visibile sopra il globo.
